scripts.dev: bun run build:library && bun run native:build && bun src/index.ts
scripts.native:build: bun scripts/build-gpuix.ts && mkdir -p dist && clang -shared -fobjc-arc -framework Cocoa -framework Carbon native/panel.m -o dist/libpanel.dylib
scripts.build: bun run build:library && bun run native:build && bun scripts/build.ts
scripts.test: bun run build:library && bun test test
scripts.test:rendering: bun run build:library && bun run native:build && bun test test/card-markdown.test.tsx
